description:
Add path-dep on jmap-jscalendar-types to crate-jmap-tasks-types/Cargo.toml, mirror calendars-types re-export pattern (both top-level named re-exports and `jscalendar` module alias), and update PLAN.md §JSCalendar complex sub-objects are serde_json::Value to remove the "a future crate provides typed JSCalendar types" wording.

Mirror exactly what landed for calendars-types in JMAP-x59i.2 (commit b73534e):
- Cargo.toml: `jmap-jscalendar-types = { workspace = true }`
- lib.rs: `pub use jmap_jscalendar_types as jscalendar;` module alias for symmetry
- lib.rs: `pub use jmap_jscalendar_types::{AbsoluteTrigger, Alert, AlertTrigger, Duration, Link, LocalDateTime, Location, NDay, OffsetTrigger, Participant, RecurrenceRule, Relation, SignedDuration, VirtualLocation};` top-level re-exports
- PLAN.md §342-349: rewrite to point at the actual crate instead of the future-crate placeholder

Do NOT pre-emptively apply the extras-preservation pattern (per JMAP-yfpq NOTES — leave for JMAP-lbdy.6 sweep).

Round-trip tests for the 13 sloppy fields stay in scope of sibling .2; this bead is plumbing only.

Acceptance:
- cargo check -p jmap-tasks-types clean
- cargo clippy -p jmap-tasks-types -- -D warnings clean
- cargo test -p jmap-tasks-types clean (no regression; new tests come in .2)
- cargo doc -p jmap-tasks-types --no-deps clean
title: Migrate jmap-tasks-types to consume jmap-jscalendar-types (path-dep + re-export + PLAN.md)
